castlenavigation-desc: Audit view for the Castle's room navigation: every room's exits, and which destinations are broken.
castlenavigation-totals: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|room|rooms}}. $2 {{PLURAL:$2|room has|rooms have}} a broken destination ($3 {{PLURAL:$3|link|links}} in total). $4 {{PLURAL:$4|room has|rooms have}} no wiki page of their own.
castlenavigation-status-nopage: No wiki page with this title
castlenavigation-noroom: No room named "$1" in the navigation map.
castlenavigation-noentry-heading: Pages asking for navigation with no map entry
castlenavigation-noentry-empty: None — every page rendering <navigation/> has an entry. (This list fills as pages are viewed.)
nfpar-tracking-category-no-entry-desc: Pages in this category contain a <navigation/> tag but have no entry in the navigation map, so they tell the reader there is nowhere to go.
castlenavigation-field-prose-help: The sentence readers see. Write it however you like; use {1}, {2} … where a destination should appear. Blank destinations below are ignored, so use the spare ones to give this room a new exit.
castlenavigation-field-allowmissing: Save even if a destination doesn't exist yet
castlenavigation-error-labelnotarget: Destination {$1} has a label but no page. Fill in the destination, or clear the label.
castlenavigation-error-unknownslot: The prose mentions $1, but there is no such destination.
castlenavigation-error-orphanslot: The prose never mentions $1, so that destination would be lost. Add it to the prose or clear the field.
castlenavigation-save-badpage: Cannot use $1 as the navigation data page.
castlenavigation-save-badjson: Could not encode the navigation data as JSON.
castlenavigation-error-missingtargets-hi: Click a red link to create the page, fix the spelling above, or tick the box below to save anyway.
